notesDelete.title: Delete note
notesDelete.message: Deletes noteId `{noteId}`. This can’t be undone (renotes, quotes, favorites, clips and so on go with it).

userFollow.title: Send follow
userFollow.message: Sends a follow request to userId `{userId}` (they get a “followed you” notification). Locked accounts need to approve it.

markRead.title: Mark all notifications as read
markRead.messageAll: Marks every notification of all logged-in accounts as read.
markRead.messageAccount: Marks every notification of account `{accountId}` as read.

registrySet.title: Write to registry
registrySet.message: Writes a value to `{path}` in the Misskey server-side registry. **This area is shared with the official Misskey web client**, so it may change how the official UI behaves (themes / settings and so on).

registryDelete.title: Delete registry value
registryDelete.message: Deletes `{path}` from the Misskey server-side registry. **This area is shared with the official Misskey web client**, so the setting is reset in the official UI too.

create.title: Create skill
create.messageAlways: Saves the AI-generated skill “{name}” as a new skill. mode=always: once saved, it is always injected into the system prompt.
create.messageHeartbeat: Saves the AI-generated skill “{name}” as a new skill. mode=heartbeat: runs automatically on every tick while HEARTBEAT is on.
create.messageTrigger: Saves the AI-generated skill “{name}” as a new skill (mode=trigger: loads automatically on {triggers}).
create.messageManual: Saves the AI-generated skill “{name}” as a new skill (mode=manual: not used until you enable it).

message_plural.one: Appends {count} character to the body of {name}. The frontmatter is left untouched.
message_plural.other: Appends {count} characters to the body of {name}. The frontmatter is left untouched.

message_plural.one: Replaces the `## {heading}` section of {name} with {count} character. If there is no such heading, it is added at the end (idempotent).
message_plural.other: Replaces the `## {heading}` section of {name} with {count} characters. If there is no such heading, it is added at the end (idempotent).

revert.title: Restore skill to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores the body of {name} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current body will be overwritten.

install.messageAlways: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore (mode=always: always injected into the system prompt).
install.messageUpdate: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore (mode={mode}). Updates the existing “{current}”.
install.messageUpdateAlways: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore (mode=always: always injected into the system prompt). Updates the existing “{current}”.

uninstall.title: Delete skill
uninstall.message: Permanently deletes {name} (v{version} / {mode} mode). Its frontmatter, body and edit history file are all removed. This can’t be undone.

revert.title: Restore theme to an earlier state

install.message: Fetches {name} ({base} / by {author}) from MisStore and installs it.

uninstall.title: Delete theme
uninstall.message: Permanently deletes {name} ({base}). You’ll need to reinstall it to get it back.

setActive.title: Enable plugin
setActive.message: Enables {name}. Its handlers start, and operations covered by the permissions below may run.

delete.title: Delete plugin
delete.message: Deletes {name}. Its AiScript source, metadata and Mk:save storage are all removed. This can’t be undone.

revert.title: Restore plugin to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores {name} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current AiScript source will be overwritten.

install.message: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore. It starts automatically with active=true right after installation.
install.upToDate: {name} is already installed and up to date. Only a reference from the global scope will be added.

delete.title: Delete widget
delete.message: Deletes {name}. Its AiScript source, metadata and Mk:save storage are all removed. This can’t be undone.

messageMany_plural.one: Deletes {name} and {count} other. Their AiScript source, metadata and Mk:save storage are all removed. This can’t be undone.
messageMany_plural.other: Deletes {name} and {count} others. Their AiScript source, metadata and Mk:save storage are all removed. This can’t be undone.

revert.title: Restore widget to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores {name} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current AiScript source will be overwritten.

install.title: Install widget from MisStore
install.messageAutoRun: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore. It runs automatically when its column is shown.
install.messageManual: Fetches {name} (v{version} / by {author}) from MisStore. Auto-run is off (start it manually).
install.upToDate: {name} is already installed and up to date.

misstore.updateConfirm:
Updates “{name}” with the content from the store.
Store updated: {date} / v{version}

message_plural.one: Replaces the whole content of custom.css with {count} character. The current CSS is saved to the history and can be restored with styles.revert.
message_plural.other: Replaces the whole content of custom.css with {count} characters. The current CSS is saved to the history and can be restored with styles.revert.

message_plural.one: Appends {count} character to the end of custom.css. Existing rules are kept.
message_plural.other: Appends {count} characters to the end of custom.css. Existing rules are kept.

revert.title: Restore custom CSS to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores custom.css to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current CSS will be overwritten (the restore itself is also recorded in the history).

revert.title: Restore memo to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores memo {key} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current body will be overwritten.

revert.title: Restore query to an earlier state
revert.message: Restores {name} to edit history #{index} ({at}). The current source will be overwritten.

heartbeat.stoppedDailyLimit: HEARTBEAT stopped (reached today’s limit of {limit} AI runs)
heartbeat.overDailyLimit: HEARTBEAT: exceeded today’s limit of {limit} AI runs (still running)
heartbeat.stoppedFailures: HEARTBEAT stopped (failed {count} times in a row)
heartbeat.draftNeedsAccount: Can’t make a draft without an accountId

ai.httpForbidden: Problem with the API key’s permissions or billing (HTTP {status}){detail} — check the balance and the API key’s permissions in the provider’s console
ai.rateLimited: Rate limit reached. Wait a moment and try again
ai.notAiProvider: The selected connection is not an AI provider
ai.apiKeyMissing: No API key is set for the connection “{name}”
ai.requestTooLarge: The request is too large ({size} KB / limit {max} KB). Split long text or delete unneeded history.
ai.budgetExceeded: Exceeds the token budget ({budget} tokens today): used {spent} + estimated {estimate}
ai.roundLimit:
{partial}

⚠️ Reached the limit of {max} tool calls.

backup.restoredRenamed: Restored under another name (conflicts with existing): {items} → {renamed}

memos.revert: Revert memo to a past state

performance.resetAll: Reset all performance values to default

plugins.revert: Revert plugin to a past state

queries.revert: Revert query to a past state

skills.revert: Revert skill to a past state

styles.revert: Revert custom CSS to a past state

theme.revert: Revert theme to a past state

widgets.revert: Revert widget to a past state
